exact.A leggyakoribb tőszám, a szokásos vetési: The most common seeding rate, the usual sowing time and the year types: what local farmers do, and which years were weak or good.
exact.Az érési csoportok és a tőszámsávok ered: Results of maturity groups and seeding-rate bands by year type. The bold number is the column's best. The demo clearly shows that in drought years thinner sowing and early hybrids won, and the reverse in good years.
exact.Ha kipróbálta, itt vált a saját tábláira: When you have tried it, switch to your own fields here. Restart the tour any time by tapping the 🧪 Demo button.
exact.A hibridek kódnévvel és érési csoporttal: Hybrids appear with a code name and maturity group; you also see your own hybrids by name.
exact.Ezt a hibridet / fajtát Ön is termeli. A: You grow this hybrid / variety too. Only you see its name.
exact.A közös statisztikában a hibridek és faj: In the shared statistics, hybrids and varieties appear not by trade name but by a fixed code name (e.g. K-417), together with the maturity group (FAO band for maize; for other crops, the early / medium / late third within the crop) and the response type. The code is not derived from the name; the link to the name exists only on the server. Everyone also sees their own hybrids by name, so they can compare them with hybrids of a similar type. Exact FAO numbers are not shown.

exact.A fájlok nem kerülnek fel a szerverre: a: The files are not uploaded to the server: the app processes them in the browser, and only the finished field and map go to the cloud. So a folder of several GB is no problem.
